German intelligence has indicated that the satellite, known as Sputnik-S, has been assembled and stored for years. Dmitry Medvedev cites international law to justify potential nuclear weapon use, asserting state survival rights. He argues that international law permits nuclear usage in dire circumstances that threaten national existence.

title: 'Entitled to live with dignity': Delhi HC orders couple to vacate father's house
description: In a landmark ruling, the Delhi High Court determined that an elderly individual is not obligated to demonstrate harassment to seek eviction of his offspring. An 85-year-old man had sought to remove his son and daughter-in-law from his residence, and the court mandated their departure within four weeks, recognizing the senior citizen's right to a tranquil living environment.

title: 'Really disappointed': Hayden takes aim at 2018 Australian side over Sandpapergate

He argues that collective accountability among players is crucial for the integrity of Australian cricket. Meanwhile, captain Pat Cummins has confidently dismissed recent accusations. As the cricket calendar gears up for matches against England and New Zealand, Hayden believes focus will soon return to the sport itself, overshadowing the scandal discussions.

title: IIT-B replacing hostel ceiling fan rods amid safety concerns
description: IIT-B is initiating a replacement of ceiling fan rods in Hostel 4 and other hostels. This measure aims to enhance student safety following the death of student Sahil Wakode. The process will begin on November 22 and will extend to other hostels later. Students' feedback and representative consultations are part of the initiative to identify improvements. Protests demanding investigations and better grievance systems occurred after Wakode's tragic death.

title: Shubman Gill reveals why Team India cancelled planned activity after Wellington Test
description: India's cricket team faced a challenging Test match against New Zealand, requiring their bowlers to deliver extensive overs. Captain Shubman Gill acknowledged the bowlers' efforts and canceled planned team activities to provide them with a break. He emphasized the need for ICC to lift the ban on using saliva to maintain the ball's condition. Gill pointed out that a softer ball makes it harder for bowlers to claim wickets effectively.

He had recently borrowed funds to cover his daughter Shivani's engagement costs, causing significant financial stress. Following the ceremony, he voiced anxieties regarding expenses for her wedding scheduled for May 2027. His family found him in critical condition after he failed to return home, prompting an investigation into the troubling situation surrounding his death.

Following nearly a decade, the Motor Accident Claims Tribunal awarded him Rs 21.66 lakh in compensation. The award included 9% annual interest and directed payment from both the truck owner and insurance company.

They missed their flight after the Delhi Duronto Express train was delayed for nearly four hours. The couple incurred expenses for new flight tickets and hotel accommodation. A district consumer court ruled in their favor, citing deficiency of service by the railways. The railways failed to provide evidence justifying the delay caused by fog.

The couple had been in a relationship for three-and-a-half years and often fought over trivial issues. Following a dinner outing, a violent argument escalated, leading to the woman's death. Her cousin reported her unresponsiveness to the police, prompting their intervention. The police discovered her unconscious, and she was pronounced dead shortly after.

Initially doubted by his parents, he financed his education with the profits from his farming venture. His success has not only brought him financial rewards but also respect within the agricultural sector. Now, he sets his sights on international markets, showcasing the transformative power of farming in Assam.

Following an 11-day interim period led by Colette Kress, who retains her role as chief financial officer, investor confidence has rebounded as evidenced by a rise in Nvidia shares. While Huang cooperates with ongoing investigations, the company is enhancing governance by seeking a new Chief Compliance Officer and adopting additional oversight protocols.

Following the collision, he fled the scene, oblivious to the severity of the accident. Later that evening, police arrested him as they compiled evidence. The victims' families are now pursuing justice and compensation for their devastating loss.

He spent 18 days in custody and faced severe questioning regarding his possession. His family arranged a lawyer and paid a fine of nearly Rs 18 lakh for his release. After returning home, he is currently receiving treatment for typhoid and malaria.

description: Delhi's cycling safety is compromised by parked vehicles and wrong-way driving, according to a recent study. Cyclists face a significantly higher crash risk due to various roadside activities and poor road management. Eliminating on-street parking could substantially reduce non-fatal bicycle crashes, highlighting the need for better infrastructure. Researchers recommend dedicated cycling tracks and stronger enforcement against traffic violations to enhance cyclist safety.

The total number of accidents rose by 13% from the previous year, highlighting alarming trends. Key factors contributing to these accidents include speeding and inadequate road infrastructure, according to officials. Experts emphasized the need for institutional accountability and greater investment in road safety measures.
